title: 0.1.0-r51 P3-07 AARE (pre-5LN source pin)
description: Source and build identity for Oct-08 TestPro MMS Security association pass, before r52–r55 5-LN cert-model changes. Do not deploy rolling lab/tg544-openwrt/ccli-bin from main without rebuilding at this release.

reference_binary.note: Oct-09 Federico deploy manifest; not the mislabeled 7776624 B blob at 4c73add in git ccli-bin

requirements: REQ-VER-002: scripts/sync-ccli-version.ps1 then PKG_RELEASE:=51 in package/ccli/Makefile
REQ-BLD-003: write-deploy-manifest.ps1 before upload; SHA256 must match rebuilt binary
REQ-TSP-001: PC-B 192.168.10.10; TSP uses client_tls.pem + client_acse.key for MMS
REQ-LOG-001: DUT log iso session CONNECT -> ACSE auth ACCEPT -> AARE responder auth [10]EXTERNAL
anti_patterns: Deploying git ccli-bin at 4c73add without rebuild (often reports r30 at runtime)
SkipVersionCheck without archiving as ccli-bin.r51 and documenting actual strings --version
Hand-copy ccli-bin without apk add — apk metadata may lie; trust /usr/sbin/ccli --version and sha256
